label: VALIDATION_COORDINATES_NOTZERO
definition: A Validation Test, applied to a SingleRecord, that evaluates: Are the values of either dwc:decimalLatitude or dwc:decimalLongitude numbers that are not equal to 0? It returns: INTERNAL_PREREQUISITES_NOT_MET if dwc:decimalLatitude is bdqval:Empty or is not interpretable as a number, or dwc:decimalLongitude is bdqval:Empty or is not interpretable as a number; COMPLIANT if either the value of dwc:decimalLatitude is not = 0 or the value of dwc:decimalLongitude is not = 0; otherwise NOT_COMPLIANT.
description: Are the values of either dwc:decimalLatitude or dwc:decimalLongitude numbers that are not equal to 0?
notes: A record with 0.0 is interpreted as the string "0".
expectedResponse: INTERNAL_PREREQUISITES_NOT_MET if dwc:decimalLatitude is bdqval:Empty or is not interpretable as a number, or dwc:decimalLongitude is bdqval:Empty or is not interpretable as a number; COMPLIANT if either the value of dwc:decimalLatitude is not = 0 or the value of dwc:decimalLongitude is not = 0; otherwise NOT_COMPLIANT
examples: [dwc:decimalLatitude="21.0534", dwc:decimalLongitude="81.0554": Response.status=RUN_HAS_RESULT, Response.result=COMPLIANT, Response.comment="dwc:decimalLatitude and dwc:decimalLongitude are not zero"],[dwc:decimalLatitude="0", dwc:decimalLongitude="0",: Response.status=RUN_HAS_RESULT, Response.result=NOT_COMPLIANT, Response.comment="dwc:decimalLatitude and dwc:decimalLongitude are zero"]
references: • Chapman AD and Wieczorek JR (2020) Georeferencing Best Practices. Copenhagen: GBIF Secretariat. https://doi.org/10.15468/doc-gg7h-s853

label: MULTIRECORD_MEASURE_QA_COORDINATES_NOTZERO
prefLabel: Measurement over MultiRecord for QualityAssurance of Validation Coordinates Not Zero
definition: A Measure, applied to a MultiRecord, that evaluates for quality assurance: Measure if all VALIDATION_COORDINATES_NOTZERO in a record set are COMPLIANT. It returns: COMPLETE if every VALIDATION_COORDINATES_NOTZERO in the MultiRecord has Response.result=COMPLIANT; otherwise NOT_COMPLETE. It is based on the aggregated outcomes of the Test(s): VALIDATION_COORDINATES_NOTZERO.
description: Measure if all VALIDATION_COORDINATES_NOTZERO in a record set are COMPLIANT.
notes: For Quality Assurance, filter record set until this measure is COMPLETE.
expectedResponse: COMPLETE if every VALIDATION_COORDINATES_NOTZERO in the MultiRecord has Response.result=COMPLIANT; otherwise NOT_COMPLETE.
references: Veiga AK, Saraiva AM, Chapman AD, Morris PJ, Gendreau C, Schigel D, Robertson TJ (2017). A conceptual framework for quality assessment and management of biodiversity data. PLOS ONE 12(6): e0178731. https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0178731

label: MULTIRECORD_MEASURE_COUNT_COMPLIANT_COORDINATES_NOTZERO
prefLabel: Measurement over MultiRecord Counting Compliance of Validation Coordinates Not Zero
definition: A Measure, applied to a MultiRecord, that evaluates for quality control: Count the number of VALIDATION_COORDINATES_NOTZERO in a record set that are COMPLIANT. It returns: Count the number of VALIDATION_COORDINATES_NOTZERO in the MultiRecord that have Response.result=COMPLIANT. It is based on the aggregated outcomes of the Test(s): VALIDATION_COORDINATES_NOTZERO.
description: Count the number of VALIDATION_COORDINATES_NOTZERO in a record set that are COMPLIANT.
notes: For Quality Control, compare the Response.result of this measure with the total number of records to assess work needed on the record set.
expectedResponse: Count the number of VALIDATION_COORDINATES_NOTZERO in the MultiRecord that have Response.result=COMPLIANT.
